Title: Subscription default to Subscribe & Save
Hypothesis: Because the PDP defaults to One-time purchase while Ghost, PVL, and Transparent Labs all pre-select Subscribe & Save, we believe defaulting the selector to Subscribe & Save with flexibility copy (cancel, pause, or skip anytime) will increase subscription take-rate for all PDP buyers. True when subscription-attached orders rise without a drop in overall purchase rate.
Variant: Subscribe & Save pre-selected + microcopy: $XX.XX/order, 15% off every order, cancel/pause/skip anytime
Primary Metric: % of orders with an active subscription
Secondary Metrics: Revenue/PDP visitor, projected LTV, one-time-to-sub switch rate
Guardrail Metrics: Overall PDP-to-purchase rate (must not drop), 30-day cancel/refund rate
Dependencies: None. Pre-commit ship rule for sub-revenue vs purchase-rate trade-off

Title: Trust strip under Add-to-Cart
Hypothesis: Because Magnum shows no guarantee, testing badge, or risk reversal near the CTA (unlike 1st Phorm money-back and BPN NSF/GMP), we believe adding a trust strip (satisfaction guarantee, free-shipping threshold, Kosher/gluten-free/dye-free badges) directly below Add-to-Cart will increase add-to-cart rate. True when ATC rate rises with purchase rate holding or improving.
Variant: Trust strip block below ATC: guarantee + free-ship threshold + product certifications
Dependencies: Metric swapped from purchase to ATC: purchase-primary needs 6-7 wks at 1.88%. First ATF test

Title: Per-serving cost framing at price
Hypothesis: Because the $69.99 Quattro price has no value anchor against cheaper whey, we believe adding 'as low as $X/serving' at the price (using subscription price when selected) will reduce price hesitation and increase add-to-cart rate, especially on 4lb and protein SKUs.
Variant: Price + 'as low as $X.XX/serving' (recomputes for Subscribe & Save)
Secondary Metrics: 4lb vs 2lb size mix, subscription attach rate
Min Duration: 2 weeks (extend to 3-4 if subset traffic small)
Dependencies: Run AFTER TEST-1 ships; per-serving line reinforces subscription price and would confound if concurrent

Title: Enriched sticky Add-to-Cart (mobile)
Hypothesis: Because the mobile sticky bar shows only Add to cart, forcing a scroll-up to confirm flavor and price, we believe adding thumbnail + live price + selected variant to the sticky bar will increase mobile add-to-cart rate with no desktop regression.
Variant: Sticky bar with featured image + live price + selected variant
Dependencies: Isolated component, safe to run parallel with TEST-1

Title: Outcome-led benefit bullets above the fold
Hypothesis: Because Magnum's strongest differentiator (zero bloat, lactose-friendly) is buried in a feature list, we believe surfacing 3-4 outcome-led benefit bullets above the fold will increase add-to-cart rate by helping visitors grasp 'why this product' within 5 seconds, mirroring PVL's outcome-led hook.
Variant: 4 icon bullets, e.g. protein: Zero gas/bloating, 30g 4-source protein, Lactose-friendly, Kosher & gluten-free (pre-workout gets its own set)
Dependencies: Another ATF change; run AFTER TEST-2 concludes to avoid confounding
